title: WordCamp US 2026 – Guide to Phoenix
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…WordCamp US is packing its bags for Phoenix this August 16–19?

Pack your laptop (and sunscreen). Contributor Day opens things up with a full day of community bug-squashing, then it's talks on AI, dev skills, and WordPress basics, a Showcase Day of real sites, a Happiness Bar for troubleshooting, and a Career Corner if you're job hunting.

Grab a ticket and book your hotel — rooms are filling up fast!
